'''Kosh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of Master [[Bacara (Jedi)|Bacara]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Around [[3640 BBY]], Kosh and [[Bacara (Jedi)|Bacara]] were stationed at the [[Kri-Ta Outpost]] in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] on [[Voss]]. Upon finding ancient Jedi technology in the old ruins, they were ambushed by [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] and Bacara ordered Kosh to flee before being killed by a single shot in the head. Wounded, Kosh made it back to the outpost and asked a Republic-allied individual to complete the task the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] started.<ref name="Forbidden" />
